an9.62:1.1: LXII. Nava bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame nava? Rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ kodhaṃ upanāhaṃ makkhaṃ palāsaṃ issaṃ macchariyaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave nava dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an9.62:2.1: Nava bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame nava? Rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ kodhaṃ upanāhaṃ makkhaṃ palāsaṃ issaṃ macchariyaṃ. Khemavaggo chaṭṭho.
an9.62:3.0: Tatr' uddānaṃ: Khemo ca amataṃ c' eva abhayaṃ passaddhiyena ca Nirodho anupubbo c' eva dhammaṃ pahāya bhabbena cā ti.
